# aidial_catalog_schema (Data Source)

Looks up an existing DIAL Core catalog schema without managing it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "aidial_catalog_schema" "model" {
  path = "model"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) Catalog schema path inside the bucket.

### Optional

- `bucket` (String) DIAL bucket. Defaults to "platform" when not set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `schema` (String) The catalog schema as a JSON object string.
- `schema_id` (String) The `$id` of the schema.
